description: The same bare folder as adopt-0007 with nothing added after `init`: `ci` does not pass, because a node with no security contact cannot be published (AGSC-06-36) — the writer reports AGSC-E901 and `ci` exits 1. This is why `init` prints the security contact as a step before the first build (AGSC-02-92) and why AGSC-02-94 no longer promises a green `ci` immediately after `init`. Run with the real verbs; an empty `after_init` says the publisher added nothing. Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text.
